methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page. Where the official page returned no prices (JS-only render, configurator-gated, or quote-only), reputable third-party comparison sources (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) were used and noted in provenance. accessedAt set to 2026-06-14 per dataset convention. monthlyUsd for annual-only plans is the annualized monthly rate; month-to-month rates noted where available. Birdeye and Podium publish no self-serve prices (configurator/quote-only); Yotpo's main pricing page is JS-only so SoftwareAdvice data used as primary with GetApp corroboration. BrightLocal's standard plans are quote-on-request as of June 2026 (price increase announced July 2026). Grade.us official page (grade.us/home/plans/) is authoritative over third-party per-user data.

vendors.provenance: Added 2026-11-19 after its maker stated a claim on merchynt.com (/get-listed/), which our check found on 2026-11-19; every figure was read with our crawler from merchynt.com/pricing on 2026-11-19, not taken from any message. Paige is Merchynt's subscription software that manages a local business's Google Business Profile, review replies, social posts and website, with each task either approved by the owner or published automatically. Its pages were first public on 2024-09-08, so it passed six months on 2025-03-10. Corrected 2026-11-20: Website Only (US$20/mo, a website product) and the citation software add-on (US$40/mo) had been recorded as plans; both now stand in the record's limits, and the plans are billed per Google Business Profile, not per user.

Cancellation: canceling the last or only subscription comes with no credit or refund, per the page
